verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requires additional internal links within blog content, establishing a task-local content and site-navigation behavior.
The client makes adding internal links a concrete acceptance condition that must be satisfied before blog publication.
The client specifies that the stuffed-dolls blog must link to site products and relevant blogs, changing the required link destinations.
The client extends internal linking to every blog and requires links to products and related content; removing the prior article-specific context prevents stale applicability state.
